औत्सङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Carried or placed upon the hip or flank. E.
उत्सङ्ग, and ठक् aff.

औत्सर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
 1. Omitting, leaving.
 2. Terminative, com-
pleting, relating or belonging to a final ceremony, by which the
rite is dismissed.
 3. Natural, inherent.
 4. Derivative, produced
from or of, directly and naturally.
 E. उत्सर्ग abandoned, and
ठञ् aff.

औत्सुक्य n. (-क्यं) Anxiety, perturbation, regret.
 E. उत्सुक anxious, ष्यञ् aff.
